GOOD NEWS FOR GOSCOTE LODGE area new Estate residents. former Councillor Pete Smith's campaign with local residents has been listened to by Transport West Midlands. There will be an extended new bus route from 28th September 2026 to assist residents living on the newly built Estate on/around Goscote Lodge Crescent. Pete Smith says: Back in April, when then a Councillor for the area, local residents asked me to campaign for a bus service to reach parts of the new Estate, where the walk to the nearest bus route (Goscote Lane or even Ross Road/Harden Road) is presently a walk too far. I pointed out to Transport for West Midlands that many new residents living in the new bungalows at the far end of the Estate are elderly and or disabled and particularly need this help. I am pleased to announce that Transport West Midlands has written to me recently and their letter included the following: "Thank you for your email to Transport for the West Midlands (TfWM) on behalf of residents of the new housing development in the Goscote Lane area of Walsall....... I am pleased to confirm that an agreement has now been reached for Walsall Community Transport's (WCT) Service 25 to be extended to serve the development. It is anticipated that the revised service will commence on Monday 28th September 2026, providing residents with improved services to the local bus network..." I hope to be informing each of the approximate 400 households about this very shortly, with copies of my original "case" that I put to TfWM, their initial response AND the full letter recently received from TfWM, outlining their decision. Best wishes, Pete Smith. former Independent Councillor for the area. Harden Road, Harden, Goscote & Ryecroft ward. pic below Pete Smith in Goscote Lodge Crescent today 04/08/26. UPDATE on 6/8/26.
